title: Scalar energy-weighted Q3 slice bound
question: Does the candidate energy A(q)=1+q^4 absorb the cubic growth of the actual Q3 slice with an exact finite coefficient majorant?

weighted_target.inequality: |P_0(q)| <= C A(q)^(3/4) for every real q
weighted_target.reason: For k=0,1,2,3, |q|^k <= (1+q^4)^(3/4); apply the coefficient triangle inequality.

finite_fixture.check_role: exact sample evaluations plus coefficient-majorant arithmetic; samples do not replace the all-real inequality

scope.not_closed: Only the scalar polynomial slice has an energy-weighted coefficient majorant. No operator, common-core, multivariate, spatial-history, or thermodynamic QFT theorem follows.

adversarial_review.check: The all-real scalar inequality is attributed to the coefficient triangle and the elementary |q|^k <= A^(3/4) inequalities; finite samples are only self-tests.
v=0 and a=1/4 are fixed declared slice values; no multivariate Q3 estimate is silently inferred.
The scalar majorant is not called a common-core operator bound or domain theorem.
A(q)=1+q^4 is the explicit candidate matching the cubic asymptotic; it is not declared to be the canonical full Hamiltonian.
C is recomputed from the exact slice coefficients in both arithmetic lanes; it is not hardcoded as an unexplained rate.
R235 checks the exact coefficient-majorant identity and positivity, not real-power operator domains.
No KMS/OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

qft_interface.closed: A scalar, exact energy-weighted coefficient majorant that matches the cubic Q3 slice growth.
qft_interface.open: The actual Q3 common-core map, domain invariance, multivariate energy estimate, factorial spatial incidence, first passage, exhaustion, common alpha, KMS/OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing scalar weighted interface. It selects a plausible QFT seminorm target but does not establish the full Q3 dynamics.
